facts.fact: Kenya News Agency says the Konza data centre, implemented by the Ministry of ICT through the state Konza Technopolis Development Authority, serves government departments, state agencies and private firms.
Kenya News Agency describes the Konza Technology City data centre as Tier III, 1.6 petabytes.
Kenya News Agency says the Konza National Data Center is implemented by the Ministry of ICT through the Konza Technopolis Development Authority, a government special-purpose vehicle.
Kenya News Agency says the Konza data centre serves government departments and state agencies with cloud computing services.
